Title: Ulanbator Nights
Comment:
Mostly cloudy. You'd think there'd be more stars at the end of the earth. 

Finding the Ulaanbaatar Young Adult Scene to be "somewhat less active than I had anticipated," Joseph wanders the byways of the ancient capital on another wasted Friday night. First South Bend, then DC, now Ulanbator, what next? When will it end?

The Miata rumbles over the cobble, and Joseph returns to the apartment bloc, opening another can of cabbage and another can of worms. Mostly cloudy. 

And yet. The window is quite nice. The city sprawls forth, illuminated by streetlights, televisions through windows, light lamps in nurseries and yak dairies. Joseph gazes out with glistening eye and smiles. Another cloudy bright Ulaanbaatar night.
